title: 5 第五章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

都竞华用关键词搜索论坛，确定了一件事。

非法玩家数量很少，目前跟合法玩家之间被认为是1:999的关系，还可能更低。而且一旦发现非法玩家，游戏就会即刻下发任务，要求合法玩家对其进行清缴。正因如此，大多数不明所以的非法玩家都会倒在成功登录之前。

都竞华想起系统提示中那句“友情提醒，根据综合统计，97%的用户偏向于在较安全地点进行奖励查看，祝您好运”。

话是真话，可里面却带着显著的误导意思。虽然97%的用户都选择在较安全的地点进行奖励查看，可系统却没说，如此选择的玩家一定会能拥有更美好的结局。

要是都竞华选择直接回家，到住处再查看自己的奖励，早就被追击而来的袭击者清空了血条。即使侥幸逃脱，也会暴露自己的住址，从而暴露真实身份。

都竞华十分清晰地意识到了自己的处境有多么危险。

游戏想要干掉自己，现阶段虽然可喜可贺的失败了，可谁能保证事后不会再接再厉？说不定现在就已经开始准备下一场追杀。

不过看论坛中玩家的态度，二次袭击应当并非简单的事情，否则他们不会表现得如此暴躁。

必须抓紧时间提升实力。

都竞华在论坛上耐心地翻找。热度高的帖子五花八门，有介绍阵营情况的，有介绍游戏技能的，有分享升级技巧的。都竞华查询到许多信息，也更清晰地理解了技能后括号里的字母是什么意思。

技能最低为N级，然后是R、SR、SSR等。目前只有N级技能跟R级技能有强度划分，sr及以上的技能都没有。

至于SSR之上还有什么分类，分享者遗憾地表示现阶段信息太少，还无法确定。

不过高热度的帖子中不少都无法点开，系统给的提示很简单，只说都竞华不满足定等级，还有帖子仅欢迎某个属性达到一定数值的玩家浏览，有些则完全是模糊一片。

都竞华甚至还搜到过发帖人昵称是一片星号，帖子标题是一片星号，主题内容同样是一片星号的帖子。

“……”

都竞华默默关闭论坛，]×1，[技能升级卡]×2。

[大众脸·昵称未曾注册（可升级，已绑定，唯一）：佩戴上大众脸，无论线上线下，你都是最大众的玩家。备注：该物品的设计图纸来自▇▇与▇▇，不占道具位。]

都竞华看着备注中的黑框，久久无言，随后认真理解了一下，觉得[大众脸·昵称未曾注册]就是专门为非法玩家准备的道具，用处是掩饰她真正的阵营身份。

然而需要掩饰，就证明存在游戏中存在探查类技能，而且括号中的“可升级”同样让都竞华有些在意。目前的[大众脸·昵称未曾注册]是一样蓝色物品，算是精良级的伪装型装备，而且很有可能是非法玩家的通关标配奖励，但随着玩家实力的提升，迟早会跟不上时代。

她得在下一轮危机到来之前完成装备品质的提升。

除此之外，也有许多帖子分享自己遇到非法玩家的经历，其中狩猎成功率高达99%。

在大众眼中，非法玩家就像是移动的藏宝箱，能让完成任务的新人获得令人羡慕的收益。

都竞华起身给自己倒了杯水，西区连饮用水中都有着淡淡的涩味。

都竞华放下印着赠品字样的杯子，将自己扔进沙发椅中。

怪不得解决完临时事件后自己状态会自动切换到精力充沛，可能是因为游戏知道她只要看了论坛就很容易自动失眠。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Du Jinghua searched the forum with keywords and determined one thing.

The number of illegal players is very small, and the relationship between them and legal players is currently considered to be 1:999, and it may be even lower.And once an illegal player is discovered, the game will immediately issue a task and require legal players to clear them up.Because of this, most uninformed illegal players fail before successfully logging in.

Du Jinghua remembered the sentence in the system prompt: "Friendly reminder, according to comprehensive statistics, 97% of users prefer to check rewards in safer locations. I wish you good luck."

The words were true, but they contained obvious misleading meaning.Although 97% of users choose to view rewards in a safer location, the system does not say that players who choose this way will definitely have a better ending.

If Du Jinghua had chosen to go home directly and check his rewards at his residence, his health bar would have been emptied by the chasing attackers.Even if you get away with it, your address will be revealed and your true identity will be exposed.

Du Jinghua clearly realized how dangerous his situation was.

The game wants to kill itself. Although it has failed gratifyingly at this stage, who can guarantee that it will not make persistent efforts later?Maybe they are already preparing for the next chase now.

However, judging from the attitudes of the players in the forum, the second attack should not be a simple matter, otherwise they would not be so violent.

We must seize the time to improve our strength.

Du Jinghua patiently rummaged through the forum.There are many popular posts, some introducing camp conditions, some introducing game skills, and some sharing upgrade tips.Du Jinghua found a lot of information and had a clearer understanding of what the letters in brackets after the skills meant.

The lowest skill level is N, then R, SR, SSR, etc.Currently, only N-level skills and R-level skills have intensity divisions, while SR and above skills do not.

As for what other classifications are above SSR, the sharer regretted that there is too little information at this stage and cannot be determined yet.

However, many of the highly popular posts cannot be clicked. The prompts given by the system are very simple, saying only that Du Jinghua does not meet the required level. Some posts only welcome players with a certain attribute reaching a certain value to browse, and some are completely vague.

Du Jinghua even searched for posts where the poster's nickname was an asterisk, the post title was an asterisk, and the subject content was also an asterisk.

"..."

Du Jinghua silently closed the forum, ]×1, [Skill Upgrade Card]×2.

[Public Face·Nickname has not been registered (upgradeable, bound, unique): Wearing the Popular Face, you are the most popular player no matter online or offline.Note: The design drawings of this item come from ▇▇ and ▇▇ and do not occupy the prop space.]

Du Jinghua looked at the black box in the note and was speechless for a long time. Then he understood it carefully and felt that [Public Face·Nickname Not Registered] was a prop specially prepared for illegal players, and was used to conceal her true camp identity.

However, the need to hide it proves that there are detection skills in the game, and the "upgradeable" in the brackets also makes Du Jinghua a little concerned.The current [Public face·Nickname has not been registered] is a blue item, which is considered to be sophisticated camouflage equipment, and is likely to be a standard reward for illegal players to pass the game. However, as the player's strength increases, sooner or later it will be unable to keep up with the times.

She had to complete the upgrade of equipment quality before the next round of crisis came.

In addition, there are many posts sharing their experiences of encountering illegal players, among which the hunting success rate is as high as 99%.

In the eyes of the public, illegal players are like moving treasure chests, allowing newcomers to complete tasks to obtain enviable profits.

Du Jinghua stood up and poured himself a glass of water. Even the drinking water in West District had a faint astringency.

Du Jinghua put down the cup with the word "giveaway" on it and threw himself into the sofa chair.

No wonder her state automatically switches to energetic after solving the temporary incident. Maybe it's because the game knows that she can easily lose sleep just by reading the forum.
